name: Scanner ← Cloud Config Fetch (gRPC)
description: HUB (Lansweeper.IT) pulls scanning configuration from cloud via authenticated gRPC. All gRPC traffic is multiplexed through Discovery Gateway, dispatched server-side to discovery-config-api, which calls scanning-config internally to read the actual config.

annotations.text: On-prem agent — successor of On-Prem Classic. .NET / GrpcClientFactory configured via DiscoveryGateway:Url. Uses M2M token for authentication.
gRPC server — IGrpcConfigService.GetScanningConfig (also IGrpcLicenseService, IGrpcLinkingService, IGrpcConfigNoAuthService). Owned by Discovery Engineering.
Source of truth for scanning config. Called internally over gRPC by discovery-config-api.
